# VSA-2026-47 — runner artifact token exposure

Status: Active  
Severity: High  
Owner: Security Response

Orbit Runner 5.4.0 and 5.4.1 can expose a short-lived artifact token when a cancelled job retries its upload step. Runner 5.4.2 contains the fix. Production promotion requires Runner 5.4.2 or newer; compensating controls do not waive the upgrade requirement.
